description.p: Scripta is a distraction-free, Markdown-first note-taking app crafted with elegance and speed. Designed with an adaptive column layout, it feels at home on Desktop, Tablet, and Mobile.

ul.li: Dual mode: seamless switching between Rich Markdown preview and editing
Code blocks with syntax styling, selectable text, and one-click copy button
Distraction-Free Focus Mode with zero clutter
Contextual Markdown formatting toolbar with one-click styling
Deep folder and subfolder organization with custom note ordering
Multiple crafted themes including Scripta Dark Teal and OLED Pure Black
Full internationalization supporting English, Italian, and French

description.p: Initial release of Scripta with adaptive layout, dual mode editor, focus mode, and multi-language support.
